Video Access

How Lessons Unlock on Englishine

Englishine videos can be organized by stage, term, unit, and lesson. Some videos may be free previews, while full curriculum access depends on the student's plan.

01

Free Preview

Some selected lessons and reels may be available publicly so students can understand the teaching style.

02

Locked Lessons

Full curriculum explanations, exercise solutions, and revision videos may require an active subscription.

03

Coming Soon Lessons

Lessons that are not recorded yet can still appear in the learning path, clearly marked as coming soon.

04

Stage-Based Access

Students can receive access based on their school stage, selected programme, and learning needs.

Questions About Access

Subscription FAQ

Clear answers about prices, video access, learning paths, and the current platform setup.

Contact Englishine
Are prices available now?

Final prices are coming soon. Students can book a placement test or contact Englishine to ask about available plans.

Can I watch all videos immediately?

Video access may depend on the student's stage, subscription, and learning plan. Some lessons may unlock gradually.

Are there free videos?

Yes. Englishine may provide selected free previews and reels, while full curriculum access can require a subscription.

What if my lesson is marked Coming Soon?

Coming Soon lessons are included in the learning path and will be added as recording continues.

Which plan should I choose?

The best plan depends on the student's stage, level, and goals. A free placement test can help choose the right direction.

Is payment available on the website now?

Online payment is not active yet. The page currently explains the available subscription options and access structure.
